cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Credit for the Impossible
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I believed the cupboard before it learned to speak. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. One quick acknowledgment, then I'll respect its wishes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says you talk too much.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An informed opinion formed over years of my support.

mechanism: A hosts a talking cupboard and gives up spoken ceremony for written credit while claiming its criticism proves A long prior support.
confusable: Unlike generic attention seeking, A needs acknowledgment of belief before the impossible speech began.
comparison: Quiet written recognition differs from public credit to staircase users.
seedUse: D153-b cupboard silence and years of support; S02-b reduces ceremony and speech to keep cooperation.
